name: Human liver, serial section 02 (Xenium, SpatialData)
description: Serial section 02 of human liver sample NIH_F5 (seven Xenium sections, 01 to 08 without 03) on the 377-gene Multi-Tissue panel, read from a zipped SpatialData store: 51,117 cells with their boundaries and annotated cell types over the morphology image; opens on CYP3A4 (pericentral hepatocytes).

source.citation: Jin Y et al. (2026) LYNX: a deep generative model for linking spatial dynamics and cell interactions in multimodal spatial data. bioRxiv. doi:10.64898/2026.07.09.737574
